ابتعثنا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثْنَا (ibtaʕaṯnā) /ib.ta.ʕaθ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اُبْتُعِثْنَا (ubtuʕiṯnā) /ub.tu.ʕiθ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
